newsitem.title: CROATIA: SOCCER-CROATIA CUTS PREMIER LEAGUE TO 12 TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CROATIA CUTS PREMIER LEAGUE TO 12 TEAMS.

text.p: The Croatian Soccer Association decided on Monday to cut its top division next season from 16 clubs to 12, Hina news agency said.
As of next season, there will be only one professional league -- Premier Division -- and five regional leagues which will have amateur status.
The move is intended to improve the quality of the competition and attract more viewers to stadiums.
Croatia Zagreb completed a double on Sunday after winning the league for the second year running with a 21-point lead over Hajduk Split. They won the national cup last week.
The national soccer body also elected Branko Miksa, former mayor of Zagreb, as its new president.
